specs.Compatible Video Game Console Models: Microsoft Xbox SERIES X, Sony PlayStation 5

features: Blazing Fast Speeds: Achieve read speeds up to 1,050MB/s and write speeds up to 1,000MB/s with USB 3.2 Gen 2 connectivity.
Compact & Lightweight: Smaller than a credit card and weighs only 42g, perfect for portability.
Robust Build Quality: Passed U.S. military-grade drop tests, ensuring durability in everyday use.
Award-Winning Design: Recognized with the 2024 Good Design Award for its ergonomic and stylish build.
High Storage Capacity: Available in capacities up to 2TB, ideal for large files like 4K videos and extensive photo libraries.

Compact and Portable: Ultra-small and lightweight KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G2 Portable SSD combine performance with a sleek and stylish housing and shock-resistant design, making it the ideal device for gamers, creators and professionals on the go
Fast Data Transfer: The external drive transfers large files, videos and gaming content with read speeds up to 1,050 MB/s and write speeds up to 1,000 MB/s through its USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface
Wide Device Compatibility: Compatible with Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S; includes USB-C to USB-C and USB-C to USB-A cables for flexible connectivity across supported devices

Memory made in Japan: Built with KIOXIA BiCS FLASH 3D flash memory to support fast data access; aluminium housing and a shock-resistant design enhance durability, while the lack of moving parts helps protect data during portable use

Everyday Storage: The 500 GB external SSD provides space for documents, photos, videos and games; KIOXIA SSD Utility helps manage, maintain and secure the drive with password protection featuring 256-bit AES hardware encryption
